items.text: Uploads now focus on your latest edits, so frequent saves do not flood the upload queue.
Moving or renaming folders no longer brings back older file versions on this Mac or your other devices.
Snapshot links now open the exact file version you shared.
When a newer file version replaces an older one, the older one now moves to Trash later and can be restored as the current version.
Version history is more complete across devices, including versions saved during quick rounds of edits.
Clear Local Files now does a better job freeing Mac storage while keeping files you still need.
The Finder folder is more reliable after login and launch, with better thumbnails and clearer upload indicators.
The Activity tab is more useful with thumbnails or file icons, quick Finder access, and one-click sharing.
Deleting and restoring folders now behaves more predictably across devices, and trashed files are removed from share links until restored.
Upload and update progress is clearer and more dependable, with better waiting, retry, and storage-full status.
The app window now matches macOS light and dark mode colors for better readability.
